caption_L1: Confirmed cases of Lyme disease in the U.S. from 2007 to 2018 is a area plot. Along the x-axis, Year is plotted on a linear scale from 2008 to 2016. Number of confirmed cases is shown along the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: There were more than 20,000 confirmed cases of Lyme Disease every year in the US between 2007 and 2018. The highest number of confirmed cases of the disease was in 2009. In that year there were 30,000 confirmed cases. The lowest number of confirmed cases of the disease was in 2012, when around 22,000 cases were confirmed.
